name: Swanson 100% Natural Chicken Broth (Warm Hydration)
whyItWorks: The ultimate liquid hydration therapy during flares. Delivers sodium and potassium to prevent dehydration and orthostatic dizziness, while warm fluid relaxes gastrointestinal spastic contractions with zero residue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pour into a mug and heat in microwave or saucepan until warm. Sip slowly throughout the day.
watchOuts: Look for natural chicken broth without added onion powder or garlic if sensitive to alliums.
